description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single-target Lightning/NE physical attacks (0.9 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Instant ATB 1], & Crystal Force Mode: Lightning (Lightning) to the user
Crystal Mode: Lightning Ability Boost, Dualcast Lightning, Zero Hone Cost to Lightning Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I: 10 single-target Lightning/NE physical attacks (2.0 each), [Quick Lightning 2], [Lightning Ability Damage +30% 2], [50% DEF/RES Pierce 2], & [Quick ATB 1] to user; Crystal Force II: Use Crystal Force II and a Lightning ability, grants [Instant ATB 1] to user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999
